The '''Paigu system''' was a system found in the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]], [[Vorzyd Cluster]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planet [[Paigu]].
